Container.Name: suplapm-plugin
Container.Overview: Supla Power Monitor Dashboard Plugin for unRAID
Container.Description:
Supla Power Monitor for unRAID
A native unRAID dashboard plugin that integrates Supla power monitoring capabilities into your unRAID dashboard.
Features: - Real-time power consumption monitoring - Supla integration for smart home automation - Dashboard tile display - Easy installation and configuration
Installation: This plugin will be installed directly into your unRAID system.
